question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chief Executive of the health insurance scheme 'Ayushman Bharat' by the National Health Authority in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__RS Sharma__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ram Sewak Sharma is a former** Indian bureaucrat.**
 
• He was the** first Director-General of the Unique Identification Authority of India and was subsequently appointed as the Chairman of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI).**
 
• He was appointed as the** CEO of the National Health Authority of India which administers the Ayushman Bharat Yojana health protection scheme.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the largest health assurance scheme in the world which aims **at providing a health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year.**
 
• Its secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over** 10.74 crores** poor and vulnerable families.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ram Mohan Rao Amara**

 
 
• ​He is a** banker** who took charge as the** Managing Director & CEO at SBI Card in January 2021**.
 
• He has been an integral part of the** State Bank of India,** India`s oldest and largest banking group.
 
 
 
• **Anil Ladha**
 
 
• He is the head of capital markets at **ICICI Bank’s investment banking subsidiary**, ICICI Securities.
